answer: Slow-capital defense. Earning power accrues like a glacier: reputation and unlock weight build per epoch served over a fixed 24-epoch horizon, so an account that matters takes days of continuous work and clones cannot compress that timeline. Payouts clear only at the wharf - a settlement checkpoint where every withdrawing account is re-inspected, attestation history checked, kin-linked balances frozen before emission releases. Bonds lock for the full horizon and forfeit on detected rings. Residual attack: buy aged accounts; price the bond above what aging costs and that trade disappears.
